notes.title: Cinematic Camera Addition
notes.notes:
Critical Gravity's first major update for 2022. There have been a host of small improvements during 2021 but the cinematic camera is the highlight of the new year.

Post-Processing effect are working again and the Soundtrack issues are fixed. 

The leaderboards are all filled up on the easy tracks but, for world record hunters, there are many tracks in hard mode open for the taking. 61 Achievements so far.

notes.title: Alpha 0.9.3.8 Update - Sensitivity Setting for Controller Inputs
notes.notes:
Here is the long overdo upgrade to steering sensitivity, which vastly improves the driving experience.
Also customized it,  'Axis Sensitivity' has been added to the Input Manager for more control.

The default Steering Axis Sensitivity has been changed from '1' to '.01' if a controller is detected.
(Tested on an X-Box Controller, Retrolink, Thrustmaster Wheel and Oculus Quest hands).

notes.title: Update Notes for September 2021
notes.notes:
Trying to get back into development on this game.

The game is now using Unity's XR System and will hopefully better for more HMDs.

Exciting news: The Keyboard Mouse Version is also included in the build. You don't need to play in VR anymore. Do remember to set your inputs to the desire controllers before racing.

ahh lots more stuff.. and more soon .. thanks Moga

notes.title: Multiplayer Alpha is Live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32139511/35e9edc6b992113ccb817a9533c9c5b982e51fd6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32139511/cc2bdc7e0ffcc07ba07b212a7d207c27a64d03a8.jpg[/img]
[i]Multiplayer Track 2[/i]

[h1]To compliment Multiplayer there have also been a huge number of updates including:[/h1]

[h1][b]Vive Support![/b][/h1] 
Yes Critical Gravity is now cross-platform VR ready. Race your friends across different platforms. Leaderboards, track times and achievement are coming soon.

The Game Lobby has been redone as a Garage. Maybe akin to some F1 variants.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32139511/29cdea5b92dc4381795f3759f178c4f9b72b7b2e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32139511/c58ae470fbb80ce6f0485c8f40227d4121810dbe.jpg[/img]

The game now has an audio engineered [b]soundtrack[/b] that progresses to your race!!! 
This is a major improvement and one of the reasons for the big file size increase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32139511/173320c41201db236364ae7b8f0df721a140b64b.jpg[/img]

The settings menu now has[b] video and audio controls[/b] to compliment the custom inputs.
All settings persist through scenes and game sessions. Everything is AutoSaved for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32139511/dc69e6312fa52ff82d034c5ef490f054ac3163d1.jpg[/img]

The base engine has been upgraded from Unity 5.6 to Unity 2018.4LTS, providing POST-Processing effects and a host of other benefits controlled in the settings menu.

The various modes and track meshes have been improved for better player experience. 

Hard Mode has an autoreset when you fall off! YAY no more space spins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32139511/0501bbd0942e91b8d78c6fbeeddcce163ac616c8.gif[/img]

Still a long way to go! Thank you all!!! Here is me loosing it after trying to show off.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=39&v=DsNCjQ4Te_I

notes.title: Updates for June 2018 -
notes.notes:
Touch Controls Integration:

Feature Updates -

No Keyboard needed
The game can now be entirely played with the touch controls and no other input.

Touch Steering
The steering wheel can now be USED FOR STEERING...heh!!.. by 'grabbing' with the touch controls and rotating.

Control Input Customization
Wheel and Pedal combinations can be added and setup in the Settings Menu.
(The input settings will read the slightest 'hover' detection on a button so be mindful when setting custom Axes or Buttons not to be 'near' a Touch Controller button you dont want to get input from.....)

more coming asap

TY all

notes.title: Critical Gravity has Released in Early Access
notes.notes:
Dear Steam Group,

Thank you for taking an interest in Critical Gravity Early Access and thank you to those early purchasers supporting the game in development. 

The game is definitely rough and while it is playable some features do not work as well as they should. The following list contains some of the issues being worked on now. 

* Controls - Controllers that are not Wheel/Pedal combos tend to be over sensative for steering, as with many race games, so a dampening setting is being added as well as a custom deadzone for axis calibration. This should allow drivers to use an XBox360 or Steam Controller without over steering being an unresolvable problem. Better control will be a constant point of improvement. Please feel free to post your comments and suggestions in the community forums. They will be greatly appreciated.

* Mouse - There are currently two mouse cursors in the game when using a hardware mouse. This issue is being addressed.

* Race start countdown - Will be uniformly applied through all tracks in an upcoming patch.

* Flipped Over Stuck - While you should be able to hit "escape" and select an option to "Resume", "Reload," or "Quit" track there may be an autoflip implemented to recover a stuck vehicles in future patches.

* NPCs - NPCs slip backwards on race start. Ideally NPCs will eventually be Machine Learning AIs that will also not slip backwards on start.

* User Guide - Initial user guide is on the way. 

* Low Speed Spin Out - The geometry of the track causes the car to spinout while accerating and turning at low speeds. This is partially due to the pipe-like shape of the track. When starting to turn at lower speeds, while also under acceleration, the tires will loose traction causing the car to spinout. Try using less gas when turning.

* More to come

Thank you again Steam Community!

notes.title: Critical Gravity is near Early Access release
notes.notes:
'Critical Gravity' alpha is nearing Early Access release for players who can't wait. It is also an opportunity for those player and developers who would like to steer the game to give their input and feedback at this early stage.

There are many non-functioning parts to the game so it will be heavily discounted in Early Access. 

Thank you Community!
